source: continuous two-person conversation playing in the room

meeting_observer_runs.minutes: Security measures for the home: alarm systems, outdoor lighting, smart locks, and security cameras; no decisions or action items.
Composting, including odor control and timeline, and buying a bicycle; no decisions or action items.

offline_diarization.interpretation: Two dominant alternating talker clusters separated in both captures. The 12-second third cluster requires labeling. k=4 over-split one talker into centroids with cosine 0.912, so k=3 is preferred. This is offline diarization, not live word attribution.

active_aec_runs.verdict: Neither mode achieved usable physical echo cancellation. Different reply counts, content, and playback duration prevent treating the attenuation delta as a paired win. Keep wallclock as default and contiguous experimental.

limitations: The two five-minute model windows heard different portions of the continuously advancing source, so their summary content is not a quality A/B.
The 6000-token roll discards pre-roll user audio when no prior assistant replies exist; generated minutes cover the post-roll segment, not all five minutes.
Meeting observer mode is silent, so it does not exercise AEC or barge-in.
The 100 ms endpoint was used only to force playback during the AEC diagnostic and is not a production endpoint setting.
Offline speaker clusters are not live speaker-conditioned Gemma context and do not provide overlapping word attribution.
